reason: Provides AI-maintained reusable shortcuts for recurring development commands, prompts, and acceptance workflows, with execution or sending requiring user interaction.

summaries.zh: 将重复的开发命令、提示词和验收指令整理为由 AI 维护的一键快捷动作，并在用户操作后执行或发送。
summaries.en: Turns recurring development commands, prompts, and acceptance instructions into AI-maintained one-click actions that run or send only after user interaction.

capabilities: maintains reusable command, prompt, and AI-instruction shortcuts
stores workspace- or session-scoped action metadata
runs user-selected development commands in the current workspace
inserts or sends user-approved prompts and AI instructions
